name: Frik Meyere
bio:
Found of PRIME BELIZE Real Estate · Frik De Meyere is a Belize-based real estate entrepreneur with over 20 years of international business experience. Originally from Belgium, he has built and led ventures across Europe and Central America. He is the founder of Prime Belize Real Estate, known for closing some of the country’s highest-value transactions, including private islands and luxury beachfront properties.

Frik grew up in a small Belgian village near the Dutch border and studied IT and emergency medical services in Ghent and Antwerp. He later earned an MBA from Flanders Business School and a second from Northwestern University’s Kellogg School of Management.

Before moving to Belize, Frik worked across sectors including real estate, food production, cosmetics, and construction. He led or invested in more than 20 startups, many of which were later sold or merged. He also completed the development and sale of over 100 residential units.
